ns2:course.label: Leading Professional Organizations and Communities
ns2:course.description: Students will develop their capacity for leadership in their current and future professional positions in business and academic research teams, as well as within their broader community. This course's activities are designed to help students understand organizational structures, effective organizations, leading other people, and application of systems thinking beyond formal organizations to communities and society. Same as AGED 470. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Graduate Student or Senior Standing Required. Not intended for Agricultural Leadership Education majors or Leadership Studies minors (for non-majors and non-minors).
